evidence: The density of iridium is 22.4 kg/dm³, which translates to an atomic density of 7.018 × 10²⁸ atoms/m³. From this the thickness of a monolayer (ML) [(7.018 × 10²⁸)/1 m³]¹/³ = 2.42 Å. The growth rate in the Ir(acac)3/C0 O3 process is 1/5.3 ML/cycle. As 4.3 oxygen atoms are adsorbed per one iridium atom deposited (reaction 3), this corresponds to 4.3/5.3 ML which is about 80% of the saturation coverage of dissociatively chemisorbed O2.
